goal: Pin the exact Graphify builder wall-clock execution timeout as a forward-only supply-chain contract amendment without implementing or executing Graphify.

verified_facts.statement: I10-P0-R1 started from protected hwm-control/main 8d0c62c5b5c147a3cfd6d0ef202850292cda2bd4, hwm-lab/main e37ea628d9c793d5e87bc8b903a9b85b4371991c, hwm-context/main d651f40d0bb3a3ef0e52fca95e5400ed3db3d772, and hwm_predictor/main 8fd669336b36064e842252d69fb4016cc526a9d4.

The accepted I10-P0 v1 supply-chain contract, ADR 0007, graph-health schema, P0 tests, I10-0072 Knowledge Delta, and Issue #72 surfaces had timeout fail-closed semantics but no exact numeric Graphify builder execution timeout; no builder_wall_clock_timeout_seconds field existed in protected hwm-control before remediation.

The historical hwm-graphify-supply-chain/v1 predecessor remains byte-for-byte immutable at Git blob a22feb23061d96e920f4a8974bdbb94de9e8988e. ADR 0007 and graph snapshot/metadata/health/query schemas also remain unchanged, and the closed core BUILD_STATUS.current_schema_versions map is not expanded.

The new authoritative hwm-graphify-supply-chain/v2 contract is exact blob f42132a2f52d1d7af84155a56a86fca2fe4d8605 and supersedes v1 without changing the Graphify release, accepted wheel, license, CPython runtime, dependency closure policy, network policy, structural command, provider deny list, or max_snapshot_bytes=67108864.

The authoritative builder timeout is exactly 900 seconds on a monotonic wall clock, beginning only at verified-wheelhouse-ready, network-denied, read-only-exact-source-ready and ending only at canonical-artifact-emission-complete. It covers offline installation, exact structural Graphify invocation, output parsing, normalization, schema validation, digest calculation, and canonical artifact emission.

At 900 seconds the process tree is terminated; partial snapshot/metadata is rejected; partial canonical artifacts are deleted; health is exactly timeout_incomplete_build; usable=false; snapshot identity is null; publication is forbidden; the consumer uses deterministic raw-source fallback; and retry is only a new clean disposable execution with the same exact inputs and no partial-output reuse.

Issue #73 cannot increase the 900-second timeout after failure; any future timeout change requires another versioned contract amendment. GitHub Actions job-level containment may be longer only to record the fail-closed result and cannot alter the semantic builder timeout.

All hwm-control source mutations used only the installed controlled publisher. i10-0083-claim-v1 produced 026ed7fb3b352e4941857b8da4b87f82ad0296c7 and exposed only the active-task Knowledge Delta gate in CI 32903269083; i10-0083-claim-kd-v1 produced eacbbf660396acd6f14bd06c26d62d90efab10c8 with green claim CI 32903503517; i10-0083-source-v1 produced 7d307facea4ad014a04df44c6f6f1daaacf6837f with green source CI 32903743968.

decisions.decision: Create hwm-graphify-supply-chain/v2 as the forward-only authoritative timeout amendment for #73+ while preserving v1 as immutable historical evidence.
decisions.rationale: The exact numeric timeout was omitted from accepted P0 and cannot be retroactively invented inside v1.

decisions.decision: Use exactly 900 seconds on a monotonic wall clock for the complete builder execution boundary, with fail-closed timeout_incomplete_build behavior and clean disposable retry only.
decisions.rationale: The implementation agent must not select or silently relax a normative architecture timeout.

decisions.decision: Keep graph schemas, BUILD_STATUS core schema map, Graphify supply-chain pins, provider restrictions, and maximum snapshot size unchanged.
decisions.rationale: This task repairs only the missing execution-timeout contract.
